requirement: docs/plans/playable-target.md: two mechanically distinct viable builds per class in each act
identityRule: A build must invest more ranks in its signature skills than its same-class counterpart at the same act. Different priority order alone is insufficient. Verify actual casts, damage and summon behavior separately during role evaluation.

sourcePolicy.startingResources: Use complete native admission and preceding-wave carry from the exact complete source; never copy projected stats into a new full-health boss party.
sourcePolicy.act5Boundary: For the seven fifth-wave pre-Baal exports, wholeAreaMeasurementStart supplies the area start. The fifth-wave source is an earned internal boundary, not a fresh whole-area fixture.
sourcePolicy.points: Account for every initial learned rank and initial free skill point, level grants, claimed quest grants and consumed Book of Skill. Resets refund investment; they create no new point budget. Aggregate conservation does not prove acquisition order or reset payment history.
sourcePolicy.historicalEvidence: Preserve historical profile IDs, all failures, actual equipment and all earned preparation. Display names below clarify identity without relabeling historical trials as newly frozen intended-power populations.
sourcePolicy.populationGate: Before population or holdout evaluation, freeze per-role source/actual entry level, power/acquisition policy, manual/idle starting state, permitted adaptation costs and RNG stream advancement. This identity contract alone does not satisfy those conditions.

builds.name: Cold control
builds.mechanic: Frost Nova develops into Blizzard and Cold Mastery; Static Field supplies boss support.

builds.name: Fire spells
builds.mechanic: Fire Ball, Meteor and persistent fire spells, supported by Fire Mastery.

builds.name: Bow volleys
builds.mechanic: Multiple Shot weapon volleys with bow equipment and optional Inner Sight/Decoy support.

builds.name: Spear and lightning
builds.mechanic: Early Power Strike/Poison Javelin develops into Lightning Strike, with Impale as a physical alternative.

builds.name: Undead army
builds.mechanic: Ranked skeletons, mages, golem and summon masteries provide the main damage; curses support the army.

builds.name: Corpse and curses
builds.mechanic: Teeth supplies early spell damage; later Corpse Explosion consumes real pack corpses. Curses, hero attacks and mercenary attacks supply first kills and boss damage.
builds.roleConstraint: For Acts IV/V trash and elite fixtures, freeze an explicit learned Corpse Explosion pack rotation. Their retained boss-oriented source priorities omit it. Boss rotations may use learned curses and physical attacks when no corpse is available. Pure Bone Spear is not an added release requirement.

builds.name: Double Swing
builds.mechanic: Double Swing melee weapon sequences with warcry support.

builds.name: Double Throw
builds.mechanic: Double Throw projectile weapon sequences with warcry support.

builds.name: Zeal and auras
builds.mechanic: Zeal weapon hit sequences; a selected learned aura supplies offense or recovery/defense.

builds.name: Holy spells
builds.mechanic: Holy Bolt and Blessed Hammer provide spell damage, with a selected learned aura.

builds.name: Elemental fire
builds.mechanic: Fissure/Firestorm spell damage and Elemental Mastery; starter companions remain support.

builds.name: Animal companions
builds.mechanic: Spirit Wolves develop into Dire Wolves and Grizzly, with companion aura support.

builds.name: Martial combinations
builds.mechanic: Fists of Fire develops into Dragon Tail/Dragon Talon, with Cobra Strike recovery.

builds.name: Traps and blades
builds.mechanic: Charged Bolt/Lightning Sentry and later Blade Sentinel provide persistent trap damage.
